title: A rustle before thunder
description: Use roofed refuges to read lightning; travel during the dark interval.

signs.text: Amber warns · white lightning hurts · cross when dark
The roof keeps you low between the storm lanes
Each lane has its own warning rhythm
Climb around the tower before the next exposed crossing
Take one refuge at a time
Brake against the gust between the storm walls
Cross the high storm walk to the final shelter
